title: A primality test for $Kp^\ell - 1$ numbers
summary: We develop an algebraic framework over arbitrary quadratic fields $L = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{D})$ to generalize the Miller-Rabin primality test. Consequently, we present a deterministic primality test for integers of the form $N = K p^{\ell} - 1$ that requires only a single modular exponentiation and achieves a computational complexity of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\log^2 N)$. Furthermore, we also establish an analogue of Korselt's criterion within this setting.
